t: $(item)Compressed Iron Armor/$ is an early-game armor set which is slightly better than the equivalent $(item)Iron Armor/$ pieces; slightly higher toughness and durability, and partial knockback resistance. It can be repaired in an $(item)Anvil/$ with $(item)Compressed Iron Ingots/$.
$(item)压缩铁盔甲/$是一套前期可用的护甲，其属性比对应的$(item)铁护甲/$部件略好一些：拥有略高的韧性和耐久度，以及部分击退抗性。它可以在$(item)铁砧/$中使用$(item)压缩铁锭/$进行修复。
